peopleAlsoAsk: What are the requirements for a Thailand tourist visa?
Does a UK citizen need a tourist visa for Thailand?
Do I need 20,000 baht to enter Thailand?
Do I need a visa for a 2 week holiday to Thailand?
Does a UK citizen need a visa for Thailand?
Which is better, eVisa or visa on arrival?

items.markdown:
To visit Thailand for tourism, travelers generally need `a passport valid for at least 6 months, proof of onward travel, and sufficient funds` . Depending on your nationality, you may enter visa-free or apply for a pre-travel tourist visa online via the [Thai E-Visa Official Website](https://www.thaievisa.go.th/).[[1]](https://www.thaiembassy.com/thailand-visa/thailand-tourist-visa)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=tg3WPnqjXuY)[[3]](https://makeyourasia.com/news/thailand-entry-regulations.html)[[4]](https://www.backpackingtours.com/blog/do-i-need-a-visa-to-enter-thailand)

Passport and Entry Documents

- **Passport Validity** : Must be valid for at least 6 months from your date of arrival.
- **Blank Pages** : At least one blank passport page for the entry stamp.
- **Onward Travel** : Confirmed return or onward flight ticket out of Thailand.[](https://travel.state.gov/content/travel/en/international-travel/International-Travel-Country-Information-Pages/Thailand.html) [[1]](https://travel.state.gov/content/travel/en/international-travel/International-Travel-Country-Information-Pages/Thailand.html)[[2]](https://cibtvisas.co.uk/thailand-visa)

Financial and Accommodation Proof

- **Sufficient Funds** : Proof of funds (equivalent to 20,000 THB per person or 40,000 THB per family, or general bank statements).
- **Accommodation** : Hotel booking reservation, rental agreement, or an invitation letter from a host.[](https://london.thaiembassy.org/en/publicservice/84256-tourist-visa?menu=5f4b6eb3f6ae4b236972c562&page=5d6636cd15e39c3bd00072dd&) [[1]](https://london.thaiembassy.org/en/publicservice/84256-tourist-visa?menu=5f4b6eb3f6ae4b236972c562&page=5d6636cd15e39c3bd00072dd&)[[2]](https://www.fragomen.com/insights/do-you-need-a-visa-for-thailand-tourist-visa-rules-explained.html)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xbNwBMAWx-0&t=168)

Visa Types

- **Visa Exemption** : Eligible passport holders (such as UK citizens) can enter visa-free for short tourism stays.
- **Tourist Visa (TR)** : Required for other nationalities or longer planned stays, applied for in advance through the official e-visa portal.[](https://www.thaievisa.go.th/) [[1]](https://www.thaievisa.go.th/)[[2]](https://london.thaiembassy.org/en/page/exemp-visa)

If you share your **nationality** and **length of planned stay** , I can confirm your exact visa exemption status or application steps.
